Dividends materially change long-horizon results, but comparisons must also account for distributed cash rather than treating spent dividends as a nonexistent return.
Commission alone is an incomplete measure of trading friction; spreads, impact and execution shortfall can remain substantial.

sections.assimilation: Keep denominators, currency units, total returns and accessible investment vehicles explicit. Follow the notes' counterevidence, including Graham's inflation error and the mixed results of acquisitions, without turning either successes or failures into universal laws.
sections.adversarial_review: The corporate-dividend tax example on page 639 contradicts its own 70% deduction and 35% rate: the printed 24.50 tax is not their arithmetic consequence. Quarantine it along with all obsolete tax parameters. Gold-mining equities are not equivalent to bullion, a small position can still reduce returns, and suggested age-based percentages are unvalidated here. General bond-versus-municipal volatility claims require matched duration and credit. A changing dividend policy need not cause the profitability differences of firms selecting it. The note's statement that high interest rates reduce present value assumes a fixed cash-flow projection and appropriate discount rate. Broad claims of guaranteed survival or permanent superiority remain unsupported. The index example's pre-1976 implementation gap is explicitly admitted on page 643; it remains a hypothetical historical illustration.
sections.memory_delta: Use the correct denominators and total-return boundaries, acknowledge unavailable vehicles and missing firms, and retain changes in regime. A low price cannot rescue zero residual value, and correlation of payout or acquisition type with outcomes is not a universal causal rule.
sections.reading_provenance: Read all PDF pages 631-646.

sections.title: Appended notes, final sequence

claims.text: Value funds as well as growth funds can underperform after costs. Preserve both results rather than treating a value label as evidence of skill.
Multi-year earnings reduce dependence on a favorable single year but still require an assessment of structural change and sustainable profitability.
Historical market-timing comparisons must include dividends, subscription fees, transaction costs and taxes consistently on both sides.
Reject treating book value, tangible book value and net asset value as universally interchangeable. Record the specific balance-sheet definition and intangible adjustments used.
A tax-loss illustration depends on its stated tax year, realized gains and dividend treatment; do not reuse its numbers outside those assumptions.
claims.anchor: did not reinvest any Coke dividends

claims.text: Observed poor results after a manager leaves do not establish what the same fund would have earned had that manager stayed.
Never infer that an industry's exciting prospects make it certain to outperform. Technology adoption, business profitability and investor returns are separate outcomes.

sections.assimilation: Close the foundation with a defensive process: audited definitions, conservative but revisable business estimates, costs, diversification and explicit uncertainty. Separate source observations from counterfactual claims and forecasts. The reading supplies hypotheses and error checks; it does not establish this Character's market performance.
sections.adversarial_review: A long sample is not sufficient by itself: structural change, selection and dependence can defeat a 50-year backtest. The suggested 35-year bubble cycle and vigilance around 2030 are speculative, not an executable calendar rule. A stable industry does not imply stable equity value under leverage or accounting surprises. Infinite-growth valuation depends on growth relative to discount rates, not growth alone. A fund closing to new money can manage capacity without guaranteeing maximal future returns. Historical legal restrictions and market access descriptions remain dated. A 20-year fund result cannot automatically be attributed to one manager without matching tenure. The inheritance argument about lower cost is not a sound general reason to keep falling shares; tax basis, estate treatment and the owner's needs must be separately established. The end of one restricted-stock marking abuse does not eliminate all valuation risk. Retain failed and vanished funds rather than silently assuming their returns.
sections.memory_delta: A style label is not skill. Require consistent dividends and full costs, explicit accounting definitions, dated tax assumptions and honest counterfactual limits. Discard bubble-calendar and guaranteed-survival rhetoric; treat the complete foundation as hindsight learning pending prospective evidence.
